_about: The data as it will stand after cases 2 and 6 land, simulated locally on 2026-11-13 (S639: review an apply against the data as it will stand afterward). Written by hand from the run named in `how`.
how: Simulated, not applied: a copy of kb/ took the case 6 record (kb/_reclustering_s648_apply.py --record, then --undo-record on the repo copy, byte-identical after) and the two cohort rows (--overlay on the copy), then export_unified_courses() ran on it through its UC_KB_DIR / UC_OUT_DIR seam. The same run on the untouched kb/ reproduced the committed unified_courses_*.js except their timestamps. Identities 49,561 before and after (FIRE M1274 folds away, BUSI M11TU joins); member rows 134,485 before and after, so no course counts twice. Only these four identities' members changed and only three in-browser rows differ. The builders downstream of the export (coci_lookup, credential reference, the SkyView and CPL Pathways payloads, the row audit) were not run.
